# Ambulatory Surgery Center Association (ASCA)

> ASCA is the leading membership organization representing ambulatory surgery centers, providing advocacy, education, compliance resources, and operational support for Medicare-certified ASCs.

ASCA serves as the primary resource hub for ASC administrators, physicians, and staff, offering tools for Medicare compliance, quality reporting, benchmarking, and legislative advocacy. The organization connects members through events, educational programs, and a comprehensive directory of service providers.

## Key Topics

- Medicare compliance and payment rates
- ASC quality reporting and patient safety
- OAS CAHPS patient satisfaction surveys
- Federal regulations and HIPAA
- ASC certification and NPI registration
- Benchmarking surveys and operational metrics
- Legislative advocacy and state regulations
- Membership benefits and community engagement
- CMS payment rules and rate calculations
- ASC operations and clinical standards
- Corporate membership and vendor directory
- Patient experience measurement
- State-level ASC regulations
- Physician and staff compensation
- Medicare Beneficiary Co-Pay Fairness Act

## Organization & Membership

- [Home](https://www.aaasc.org/home): ASCA homepage providing overview of membership, events, and resources for ambulatory surgery centers.
- [About ASCA](https://www.aaasc.org/about): ASCA mission, leadership, advocacy efforts, and membership information.
- [Membership That Moves Your ASC Forward](https://www.aaasc.org/join): ASCA membership benefits including educational tools, news updates, and community access.
- [Get Involved](https://www.aaasc.org/get-involved): Opportunities for peer connection, advocacy, and community engagement with ASCA.

## Medicare Compliance & Payment

- [Medicare Rate Calculator](https://www.aaasc.org/medicare/rate-calculator): Members-only tool displaying local and national Medicare payment rates for ASC procedures.
- [Medicare Payment Resources](https://www.aaasc.org/medicare/payment-resources): Rule analyses and tools to help ASCs navigate Medicare payment regulations.
- [Medicare Certification Resources](https://www.aaasc.org/medicare/certification): Resources for obtaining Medicare certification and NPI registration for ASCs.
- [Medicare ASC Quality Reporting Program](https://www.aaasc.org/medicare/quality-reporting): Guide to quality reporting measures required for Medicare-certified ASC facilities.
- [OAS CAHPS Survey](https://www.aaasc.org/medicare/oas-cahps): Guide to OAS CAHPS patient survey measuring care experience and quality metrics.

## ASC Operations & Quality

- [Quality Reporting & Patient Safety](https://www.aaasc.org/asc-operations/quality): Resources for maintaining high-quality care and patient safety compliance.
- [Federal Regulations](https://www.aaasc.org/asc-operations/regulations): Federal regulatory updates affecting ASCs including HIPAA and Cures Act.
- [Benchmarking Surveys](https://www.aaasc.org/asc-operations/benchmarking): Clinical, operational, and salary benchmarking surveys for ASC members.
- [OAS CAHPS Survey](https://www.aaasc.org/asc-operations/oas-cahps): Patient survey guide measuring care experience and quality reporting requirements.

## Advocacy & Regulatory Resources

- [Legislative Priorities](https://www.aaasc.org/medicare/legislative-priorities): Overview of ASCA's congressional advocacy efforts and legislative priorities.
- [State Resource Center](https://www.aaasc.org/asc-operations/state-resources): Resources on state-level ASC legislation, regulations, and advocacy.

## Find & Connect

- [Find an ASC](https://www.aaasc.org/find-an-asc): Interactive map to locate Medicare-certified ambulatory surgery centers in the US.
- [Corporate Member & Affiliate Business Directory](https://www.aaasc.org/asc-operations/business-directory): Directory of corporate members and affiliate vendors serving ASCs.

## Optional

- [Marketing Opportunities](https://www.aaasc.org/marketing-opportunities): Sponsorship and advertising opportunities for vendors at ASCA events and programs.
